title: Quantum Spectrodynamics: A Framework for Deriving Standard Model Parameters from Information Geometry
description: Quantum Spectrodynamics (QSD) derives Standard Model parameters from the geometry of the [[5,1,3]] perfect quantum error-correcting code. From four inputs — the holographic bit density Hb₄ = 1/(4 ln 2), the golden ratio φ, the graph strain ς = 3/(80φ²), and the Planck mass — the framework produces with zero free parameters: α⁻¹ = 137.036 (15 ppm), sin²θ_W = 0.2312 (0.5%), m_H = 126.7 GeV (1.3%), and E_syn = 28.24 GeV (0.2% from CMS dimuon excess). This release includes the full preprint, 7 supplements, computational verification suite (NumPy + Qiskit with IBM Quantum hardware support), and a reproducible conda environment.
notes: This is the first public release of the QSD framework. Supplements S6 (string correspondence) and S7 (cosmological constant) are explicitly marked as speculative and do not affect the core predictions. Falsification criteria for LHC Run 3 are provided in Supplement S5.
